title: Early Injury Line Adjustment
subtitle: 4-State Play & Workload Probabilities (P(Play), P(Play Well), P(Limited/Decoy), P(Inactive → Void)) paired with (1) Player Prop Void-Freerolls & Complementary Beneficiary Front-Runs and (2) Unadjusted Spread & Moneyline Opportunities before official 90-minute inactives drop.

methodology.void_rule: At major sportsbooks (Book A–W), a pre-game straight player prop requires the player to take at least 1 snap for action. If a Questionable starter is ruled Inactive pre-game, their prop is 100% VOIDED/REFUNDED while your complementary beneficiary ticket remains live at a stale pre-scratch line.

four_state_model.label: P(Play)
four_state_model.desc: Probability the injured player suits up for at least 1 snap (1 − P(Void)).

four_state_model.label: P(Play Well / Full)
four_state_model.desc: Probability the player suits up AND plays their normal effective snap/usage workload.

four_state_model.label: P(Limited / Decoy)
four_state_model.desc: Probability the player suits up on a pitch count, snap limit, or decoy role (Action, not voided).

four_state_model.label: P(Inactive → Void)
four_state_model.desc: Probability the player is ruled Out/Inactive pre-game, triggering a 100% void/refund on their pre-game props.

strategies.when: Low decoy risk (P(Decoy) ≤ 15%). Take Starter Over + Beneficiary Over. If Starter is Inactive, Starter leg voids/refunds 100% while Beneficiary freerolls a 10–20+ yd line jump.
Low P(Play Well) (< 40%). Bet the WR2/TE1/RB2 Over right now before the official Out announcement moves their line.

High soft-tissue/shoulder decoy risk (P(Decoy) ≥ 24%). Pair Starter Under + Beneficiary Over (wins 2-0 if starter plays limited snaps; if Inactive, Starter Under voids and Beneficiary Over freerolls).
